stem: Legislation requires tempering valves to be installed in new hot water systems to limit bathroom water temperature to what level?
explanation: Setting the temperature to $50^\circ C$ provides enough time to remove a child from water before a burn occurs, unlike higher temperatures.
rationale: This temperature is chosen because it allows a short reaction time to prevent a burn.

optionExplanations.A: Setting the temperature to $50^\circ C$ provides enough time to remove a child from water before a burn occurs, unlike higher temperatures.
optionExplanations.B: At $60^\circ C$, it takes only $1$ second to cause a full thickness burn, making it too dangerous for domestic safety standards.
optionExplanations.C: This is the typical standard for domestic hot water tanks, but it is too hot for direct delivery to bathrooms without tempering.
optionExplanations.D: While safer, this is below the specific legislated requirement mentioned for tempering valves.
